# QR Code generator, Project Nayuki

Vendored from the official repository https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator,
tag v1.8.0, commit `720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb`.
Source: `typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts`; compiled with TypeScript
`--strict --lib DOM,DOM.Iterable,ES6 --target ES6`.
The complete MIT license is retained at the beginning of `qrcodegen.js`.
SHA-256: `6e200897a80ff15a652a5d601667856d807cec60cfc81a3a351305d69cc9dbbd`.

QR generation runs entirely on this device. The session link is never sent to a QR service.
